course.title: Statistics for Planners-I
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A recent study of how Americans spend their leisure time found that the (15) probability an employee has 2 weeks of vacation is 0.45, 1 week of vacation is 0.10 and 3 or more weeks of vacation is 0.20. Suppose, 20 workers are selected randomly, find: (i) What is the probability that only one worker has 1 week of vacation. (ii) What is the probability that at most 2 of the workers have 3 or more weeks of vacation? (iii) What is the probability that at least 2 workers have 1 week of vacation?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
